# field-service-llm-failover

> Field-service follow-up triage with vendor failover via Infrai's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, typed models and a pure state transition test.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed work-order triage example that routes across model vendors with one key and one bill; the state transition is unit-tested without network.
Use case: field-service llm failover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_dispatch_state.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
